description: This file defines an immutable Java class `ImmutableSearchProperty` implementing the `SearchProperty` interface, providing methods to create search filters based on property paths and values, primarily used for search or query purposes within the project.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchProperty
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the SearchProperty interface, providing methods to generate search filters based on property paths and values.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableSearchProperty instance with the specified property path.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Returns a filter indicating whether the property exists.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Returns an equality filter for various data types (boolean, int, long, double, String).

methods.name: ne
methods.description: Returns a 'not equal' filter for various data types.

methods.name: ge
methods.description: Returns a 'greater than or equal' filter for various data types.

methods.name: gt
methods.description: Returns a 'greater than' filter for various data types.

methods.name: le
methods.description: Returns a 'less than or equal' filter for various data types.

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Returns a 'less than' filter for various data types.

methods.name: like
methods.description: Creates a filter that matches a pattern specified by the string value.

methods.name: in
methods.description: Creates an 'in' filter with multiple values, supporting different data types.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the property path associated with this search property.
